question: Which of the following exercises was jointly conducted by the Indian Army and NDRF on May 2025 as a large-scale humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) simulation?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Raahat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raahat** was a joint exercise conducted by the **Indian Army** and the **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)**.
 
• The exercise was organized in **May 2025** as a large-scale **Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) simulation.**
 
• The purpose of this exercise was to **test the coordination and response of different agencies** during natural disasters.
 
• The exercise involved **disaster management drills**, rescue operations, and mock scenarios to prepare teams for real-life emergencies.
 
• It highlighted the importance of **collaboration between the Indian Army and NDRF** in disaster-prone areas.
 
• Such exercises help in enhancing the **preparedness** and **operational efficiency** of disaster response teams.
 
• The ultimate goal is to minimize **loss of life**, reduce damage to property, and ensure the safety of affected populations during disasters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Prakampana**__

 __
 
• **Prakampana** is a joint exercise primarily conducted by the Indian Army to test the preparedness of forces during natural calamities or emergencies.
 
• The term "Prakampana" translates to **"Cyclonic Storm"**, symbolizing its focus on disaster management.
 
• It generally includes **rescue and relief operations** in cyclonic regions.
 
 
 
• **Shakti**__
 __
 
• **Shakti** is a **bilateral military exercise** conducted between the armies of **India and France**.
 
• The focus of this exercise is on **counter-terrorism operations** and improving interoperability between the two armies.
 
• The exercise is conducted alternately in India and France.
 
 
 
• **Mitra Shakti**__
 
 
• **Mitra Shakti** is a joint exercise between the armies of **India and Sri Lanka**.
 
• The exercise focuses on **counter-insurgency and counter-terrorism operations** in semi-urban and rural environments.
 
• It aims to enhance the military cooperation and understanding between the two nations.
